title: south africas eskom announces retirement cfo calib cassim confident utilitys 2026 08 31
text:
JOHANNESBURG, Aug 31 (Reuters) - South Africa's state-owned power utility Eskom said on Monday that Group ​Chief Financial Officer Calib ​Cassim will retire during the financial ⁠year ending March 2027.
Cassim, ​who has spent 24 years ​at Eskom and also served for a year as acting Group Chief ​Executive, played a key role ​in the utility's operational recovery and ‌return ⁠to profitability.
He told Reuters he was confident his successor would build on the turnaround achieved ​under the ​current ⁠leadership team.
"I will take a rest and watch ​Eskom succeed," Cassim said.
Eskom ​said ⁠it aims to appoint his replacement before the end of ⁠the ​2026 calendar year.
